segments.he: וְהִנֵּה בִּהְיוֹתִי עַל הַסְּפִינָה הַנִּזְכֶּרֶת לְעֵיל שֶׁשָּׂכַרְנוּ, נוֹדַע לָנוּ שֶׁלּא תֵּלֵךְ הַסְּפִינָה עַד לְמָחָר רַק שֶׁבְּיוֹם זֶה כְּפִי הַנִּרְאֶה כְּבָר זָזָה מִמְּקוֹמָהּ, וּמֵחֲמַת זֶה לא הָיָה יָכוֹל רַבִּי אַבְרָהָם לְמָצְאָהּ:
segments.en: On Tuesday afternoon — Rabbi Avraham came back again and said he had seen the captain — who said that since thirty taler had been remitted from the hire yesterday, he did not wish to wait for payment any more — only to settle all the money immediately and at once to the last coin. And this too brought divided counsel and great confusion of mind. In the end — we went with Rabbi Avraham first to the Consulate house — for he said the captain's scribe was found there — and we would settle all the money and receive a written document with his signed hand. We went there — did not find him. We returned — went to the Ishmaelite court to receive a strong document for the Consul's ticket so that we could leave Istanbul — and lingered there about an hour. From there we went to the ship, settled with the captain's scribe all the money, received from him a document with his signed hand, and returned home with the intention of boarding the following day. And that day was Wednesday mentioned above — on which we boarded the ship. May Hashem Blessed be He lead us in peace to Eretz Yisroel quickly.
